preamble: Use my Mac for this. Do only what I asked: do not quit apps, close windows, or open anything else. When you are done, hand control back.

tasks.instruction: TextEdit has the empty file note.txt open. Type this sentence into it, without the quotes: "The meeting moves to room 42". Then save the file.

TextEdit has the file form.txt open. It is a form with three fields, one per line. Fill it in: after "Name:" write Ada Lovelace, after "City:" write London, after "Phone:" write 5550142. Keep each value on its field's line, then save the file.
TextEdit has the file fox.txt open. Replace the word brown with red, leaving the rest of the sentence as it is, then save the file.

write.content: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

fileEquals.text: The quick red fox jumps over the lazy dog
